title: How to have keys correspond to battle options?

posts.author: RPGMakerUser4001
posts.body:
Is there any way to have keyboard/button inputs select actor commands in battle, eg 'A' key selects the physical attack option, 'S' key opens the skill select menu?
Open to scripting ideas too. Thanks!

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
I just used the following prompt in Google AI Mode and it gave me a very nice description of options and explained it much better than I could.
"In RPG Maker MZ, how would I make it so a key press selects an option in combat, like press the A key to select Attack?"
The response covered possible existing plugins as well as how to make your own simple plugin which is similar to a key mapping plugin tutorial that I have on my YouTube channel.
The response might not be perfect, but it should give you some direction options to experiment with and further research.
Also, others might be able to provide better specific assistance without using an AI search at all, which is even better.
Good luck with your project!
